tasks.Eat_More: Increasing food intake, which can lead to weight gain and may not be beneficial for getting in shape.
tasks.Giving_Up: Stopping efforts towards achieving fitness goals.
tasks.Jogging: A form of aerobic exercise that involves running at a steady pace to improve cardiovascular health and burn calories.
tasks.Period_of_Recovery: A time when the body recovers from intense physical activity or training.
tasks.Starving: Reducing calorie intake drastically, which is not a healthy way to lose weight or get in shape.
